_about: cc-P133: THE inventory of every service on Haven and every shard service on the game PC, and the one source of Haven's dashboard. docker/haven/Build-HavenDashboard.ps1 turns it into docker/dashboard/haven/config/services.yaml and settings.yaml, so the dashboard and this file cannot drift; the console facts P133_* check that, and that every running container in a saved discovery (docker/haven/discovery/) has an entry here. Prose for a human is notes/haven-runbook.md in shard-migration. RULE (both repos' AGENTS.md): any prompt that adds, moves or removes a service on Haven or the game PC updates this file and the runbook in the same prompt. Env variables are NAMES only; no value of a password, token or key ever goes in this file. 'verified' says where each fact came from; 'unverified' means nobody has seen it yet and the Mega dashboard deploy's Discover is what confirms it. ASCII only.

cc-P668: Haven's public address at http://haven.tail81098d.ts.net:8098/ip, the game PC's DDNS gate's second way to Haven (its LAN address is the first). Plain HTTP on loopback, as Serve needs.
